youtube_description:
Total Solar Eclipse on August 21, 2017 - Close Up in Universe Sandbox

Hello everyone welcome back to Infinite Space Simulations.

Welcome to an amazing journey to the Universe! In this video, we took place in the fantasy space of the Universe Sandbox game to reproduce and show you one of the most amazing natural resources - the total solar eclipse that occurred on August 21, 2017.

Don't forget to like this video and subscribe, and put the bell icon so you don't miss new videos.


We'll start by taking a close look at our star, the Sun. Its bright colored and amazing energy will fill our Universe. Gradually, the moon and the earth are in the sky of the sun, and we see how the shadows begin to slide over the surface of the planet.

Gradually, the moon begins to block the Sun, eclipsing it completely. The magic of a sudden eclipse unfolds before us as the surroundings plunge into darkness. the stars begin to glow against the background of the eclipsing moon, which has an exceptional probability of occurrence.

We will observe how the moon completely covers the fire of the Sun, revealing the illusion of a black circle appearing in the sky. At this point, we will be able to see the solar corona, we observe a dark spot of the moon emanating from the Sun. This breathtaking spectacle reveals to us the secrets and beauty of the cosmos.

In this unique moment of immersion in the universe, we will have the opportunity to discover the scale of our solar system and see how it interacts. We watch the shadows move smoothly across the surface of the Earth, revealing a breathtaking visual effect.
